thread.title: Epic Games Is Exploiting a Loophole in Google's Mobile Ecosystem

author: admin
title: Epic Games Is Exploiting a Loophole in Google's Mobile Ecosystem
text:
Original article
Epic Games, the creator of the hit game Fortnite , is launching its own mobile app store for Android devices this year. It will run as a stand-alone Android app that will likely be downloaded from Epic's website instead of Alphabet 's (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) Google Play and will run its own non-Google app ecosystem within Android.
Epic will let developers on its platform retain 88% of an app's revenues, compared to just 70% on Google Play and Apple 's (NASDAQ: AAPL) App Store. Epic's 12% cut also includes the 5% royalty the company collects from developers using its Unreal Engine. A scene from Fortnite . Image source: Epic Games.
